[SWS_DM_01380] SOVD mode control_dtc_setting get value
⌈
The
SOVD attribute value in the response body of SOVD method Get Details of a
Single Mode of an Entity of SOVD mode control_dtc_setting shall return
the current state of the Diagnostic Server instance according to Service Con-
trolDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
